editorial:
Imagine walking into a prison that is literally burning down around you. That is where you meet Inspector Ava Williams, a sharp detective who has to figure out why this fire started. It turns out this isn't just some accident. A prisoner with a huge grudge is using the chaos to get back at the people who locked him up. The whole vibe feels like a race against time, mixing a police mystery with a scary survival story. You get to follow Ava as she pieces together the clues while the heat rises and the danger gets real.

What really works here is how the tension builds up. The acting is solid, and the twists keep you guessing about who is actually the bad guy. While some of the special effects look a bit dated since it is a TV movie, the pacing is fast enough that you won't really mind. If you enjoy tight thrillers with a revenge plot, you should definitely give this a shot.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when Ava finds the prisoner responsible for the fire. He reveals his plan to kill everyone involved in his wrongful conviction. After a tense standoff in the burning building, Ava manages to outsmart him and stop the fire from spreading further. He is finally defeated, and the truth about the corruption that put him in jail comes to light, giving some closure to the chaos.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves prison break stories and revenge mysteries.
